explanation: Original Tibia evidence is retained verbatim here. Active target fields now contain explicitly scoped Oteryn working values; no Global fact has been proven by a design choice.

original_global_fact.note: Official notes say recently active without an exact timeout.

Live official manual states 20/30/60/100%; current Wiki list states 20/35/70/100% but its worked example uses 60%. Official curve is selected separately under primary-source precedence; Wiki disagreement remains recorded.
Wiki-only precise drain algorithm; no official/controlled evidence in inspected material.
Official manual distinguishes normal/promoted caps (100/200); current Soul Point Wiki distinguishes Free/Premium accounts instead. These conditions are not equivalent.
